description: This file implements a Dart class for interacting with the NewsAPI to fetch top headlines, handling API key management, request/response processing, error handling, and parsing news articles into model objects. It also defines a custom exception class for API errors.

classes.name: NewsApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to NewsAPI interactions.

classes.name: NewsApiClient
classes.description: Client class encapsulating methods to fetch news headlines from the NewsAPI, including request handling, response validation, error processing, and article parsing.

methods.name: _maskApiKeyInUrl
methods.description: Replaces the actual API key in the URL with a masking pattern for debug logging.

methods.name: _extractNewsApiErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a meaningful error message from the decoded JSON response from NewsAPI.

methods.name: _debugLog
methods.description: Prints debug messages when Flutter's debug mode is enabled.

methods.name: fetchTopHeadlines
methods.description: Main method to fetch top headlines from NewsAPI given a country and optional category, handling network requests, JSON parsing, and error handling.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the internal HttpClient used by the API client.
